content: {"answerable": true, "answer": "A temporary resident applies with a primary document such as a work permit or a study permit that says the holder may work in Canada [s02-c500-000]. A visitor record can also be used when it states that the person may accept employment [s02-c500-000]. An original primary document that proves identity and status is required, for example a work permit, a study permit or a permanent resident card [s03-c500-000]."}
